feeds.title: FurlsCrochet
feeds.description: Furls Fiberarts is the world's premier provider of luxury crochet hooks and other fiberarts tools. In this blog you will find tutorials for Amigurumi Crochet.

feeds.title: PlanetJune Blog
feeds.description: Hello! My name is June Gilbank, and I'm a crochet pattern designer, crochet and craft book author, multi-crafter, technical writer, and animal lover. Find posts on crochet designs and tutorials, craft projects, running a craft business, PlanetJune news, and wildlife and nature.

feeds.title: lilleliis Blog
feeds.description: I`m Mari-Liis and have been making amigurumi toys since 2008. lilleliis company is designing handmade toys and crochet patterns for moms to make special toys for their kids. Our toys are combining Japanese amigurumi technique with teddy bear tradition. Bigger than the classical amigurumis, they still are very simple to make. Our toys are inspired by children and meant for playing.

feeds.title: The Crochet Crowd » Amigurumi
feeds.description: The Crochet Crowd is about community first. Led by Michael Sellick, aka Mikey. Our goal is to provide free resources such as patterns, video tutorials and more for amigurumi.

feeds.title: All About Ami Blog
feeds.description: Stephanie Jessica Lau, amigurumi & knit designer and blogger, shares helpful tips, techniques, patterns, and detailed step-by-step tutorials.

feeds.title: Sweet Softies
feeds.description: Sweet Softies is a mini amigurumi and crochet store that provides cute patterns, plushies, and dolls. Here you will find videos of crochet tips, strategies, and project tutorials!

feeds.title: Once Upon a Cheerio
feeds.description: Sharing free crochet patterns, adorable amigurumis, DIY projects, craft tutorials and other creative ideas inspired by pop culture for modern living on the blog. The author Juli Anne, a Vancouver BC resident with her family loves picking cheerios of the floor along with that she enjoys crafting, cooking and crocheting.

feeds.title: Ami Amour
feeds.description: Ami Amour is a crochet designer who creates adorable amigurumis and cute crochet patterns. Beginning in April 2006, she discovered her affinity to a yarn and a hook and found out she could magically conjure up creatures from just using fiber! Since then, she has been determined to carry out her mission in which she amasses a huge Amigurumi Army.

feeds.title: Son's Popkes
feeds.description: My name is Sonja van der Wijk and I am a Dutch crochet animal pattern designer and illustrator. I love what I do. Here at my blog you can find crochet patterns to make lively crochet animals and so much more.

feeds.title: One's Creative Mind
feeds.description: I am a single mother to an amazing little boy young man and I love all things crafty! I hope that people are as impressed with my creations as my friends and family have been. I put a lot of thought into my projects and try to focus a lot on the smaller details as well as the bigger ones. I am always open to ideas, suggestions, tips, and tricks. Thank you to all of you who actually took the time to read all about me.

feeds.title: Greatamigurumi
feeds.description: On this blog there are photos and links to free Amigurumi crochet patterns, which are published every month. It's a directory to find patterns for bears, bunnies, owls, disney related or any other category.

feeds.title: Amigurumi To Go
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Sharon Ojala. A Finnish last name pronounced O-yah-lah. I design amigurumi patterns and most of them have video tutorials. I also build dollhouses out of whatever I can, like dressers and old boots!

feeds.title: By Hook, By Hand
feeds.description: A place to share and discuss cloth and crochet dolls made by hand.

feeds.title: Krawka
feeds.description: Crochet projects and all things that are related to this wonderful hobby. Crochet projects that will amaze You are dinosaurs, aliens, zombie pirate panda, vampires, robots, Cheshire cats and other amazing projects with free patterns.

feeds.title: Supergurumi
feeds.description: In Supergurumi blog you will find Amigurumi Crochet Patterns.

feeds.title: Hello Yellow Yarn
feeds.description: Hello! I'm MJ. Mum and crocheter behind Hello Yellow Yarn. Welcome to my craft corner! I love designing adorable amigurumi most of which are inspired by my children's fun and creative personalities!

feeds.title: Mia's Atelier
feeds.description: Mia's Atelier is a blog where you can find cute and geek amigurumi patterns designed by Miahandcrafter. Moreover you will find some tutorials and crochet related posts.

feeds.title: Little Yarn Friends
feeds.description: I'm Rachel, living in sunny Singapore. A lover of artsy-craftsy things ever since I was a kid. I am a self-taught crochet-amigurumi artist. I picked up some helpful crochet skills from the Internet all thanks to other talented crochet artists from all over the world that are so generous and willing to share their knowledge.

feeds.title: Amigurumi Food
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Anneris, welcome to my little world of Amigurumi Food.

feeds.title: Tiny Rabbit Hole
feeds.description: Tiny Rabbit Hole has been inspired by some really awesome Amigurumi crocheters around the world and now, here we are, creating Amigurumi that I love dearly.

feeds.title: Heart & Sew
feeds.description: The blog of a crafter and amigurumi pattern designer. Here you will find crochet patterns shared on this page daily!

feeds.title: Amigurumi creations by Laura
feeds.description: Hello! I´m Laura. I have been crocheting since childhood and on 2009 I discovered the fun of amigurumi. For the past years I have dedicated my creativity to the craft of amigurumi and I´m passionate about creating crochet designs and handmade toys.

feeds.title: Keep Calm and Crochet On U.K » Amigurumi
feeds.description: Hello I'm Heather and I'd like to wish you a warm welcome to my little blog! I'm a thirty *cough* something, busy working wife and mum of two young daughters based in Staffordshire, UK. This is my place to share my love of all things yarny; I mainly write about my crochet and other crafty things but I also like to share little stories about my family and fun activities to do with children.

feeds.title: Crochet... Amigurumi
feeds.description: This blog is Dedicated to bringing you the cutest and awesom-est crochet amigurumi patterns. Find monthly exclusive patterns, video tutorials, giveaways, crochet-a-longs and more!

feeds.title: Ahookamigurumi
feeds.description: Hi ! My name is Ophelie and I'm 29 years old. I design fun and colorful amigurumis, often inspired by pop-culture, science-fiction and video games.

feeds.title: Little Muggles
feeds.description: I'm Amy. I created this website to share my love of amigurumi with the world! Please look around and I hope you find some fun and inspiration!

feeds.title: Amigurumi Barmy
feeds.description: Amigurumi barmy is Liz Ward crochet designs. This is where I share all my crafting adventures with the world.

feeds.title: Crafty Is Cool
feeds.description: I started CraftyisCool in 2007 when I had trouble finding Yo Gabba Gabba toys for my little boys. I crocheted my first toy and after many requests for the pattern.

feeds.title: Amigurumi Today
feeds.description: Amigurumi Today is for all who fell in love with cute crochet toys called amigurumi. Here you can find a lot of gift ideas and free amigurumi patterns. Here you will learn interesting ideas and lots of free amigurumi patterns and step-by-step tutorials.

feeds.title: Moji-Moji Design
feeds.description: I'm Janine Holmes, the owner and designer behind Moji-Moji Design. I specialize in amigurumi crochet. I love the organic way of designing in this media with just a hook, a ball of yarn and my imagination.

feeds.title: Tako-san
feeds.description: A Tako-san blog for Amigurumi patterns and design.
